_original_lore: The Weaver Spider is a spider that acts normally, but
it can also shoot webs that slow you down for a small
amount of time. Weaver Spiders can be found in the
Spider's Den, usually higher up in the nest.
name: 织网蜘蛛 (怪物)

source: The Weaver Spider is a spider that acts normally, but
it can also shoot webs that slow you down for a small
amount of time. Weaver Spiders can be found in the
Spider's Den, usually higher up in the nest.
loreParagraphs.translation: 织网蜘蛛是一种行为正常的蜘蛛,但它也能射出蛛网,在短时间内让你减速.织网蜘蛛可以在蜘蛛巢穴中找到,通常位于巢穴较高处.
